outputs: Screen summaries, action commands, question answers
Generated text summaries, answers to screen questions, and descriptions of UI elements
The model generates summaries of screen content, answers to screen-related questions, UI element descriptions, and action predictions for GUI navigation.

quote: Evaluation Metrics... accuracy computed at IoU=0.5 for UI grounding, SQuAD-F1 score for screen question answering, and CIDEr for UI referring.
...we use the accuracy computed at IoU=0.5 for UI grounding, SQuAD-F1 score for screen question answering, and CIDEr for UI referring and summarization...

For fundamental tasks, we use the accuracy computed at IoU=0.5 for UI grounding, SQuAD-F1 score for screen question answering, and CIDEr for UI referring. With regard to screen summarization, we utilize CIDEr for English evaluation and GPT-4O as the judger for Chinese evaluation...
For Chinese screen summarizations... we employ GPT-4O as the judger to score the responses from four different perspectives.
...we utilize GPT-4O as the judger and score the response from four different perspectives: Content, Structure, Fluency, Authenticity...

For Chinese summarizations, we employ GPT-4O as the judger to score the responses from the following four aspects: (1) Content: Assesses how well the summary captures the main content and functionality of the screen; (2) Structure: Judges the accuracy in reflecting the layout and structure of the screen; (3) Fluency: Evaluates the naturalness and readability of the generated text; (4) Authenticity: Measures whether the summarizations is truthful and free from hallucinations.
We recruit around 50 annotators... our data quality team conducts acceptance checks... 10% of the images are sampled for inspection.

We recruit around 50 annotators, and allocate data for each annotator on a per-image basis. Annotators are required to verify the model-generated answers and correct the errors for each assigned image. Once the human annotation is completed, our data quality team conducts acceptance checks.
